decisionsBeforeAuthoring: Every Section A question carries only the printed whole six-mark tariff. No source per-answer split or partial ladder exists. All companion prompts and paired/table answers stay visible on the whole question.
B1(a) requires two references to EACH food group: four points of six, with two analysis and four elaboration marks per point.
B1(b) is one carbohydrate account/profile with three required headings at eight each; retain original chemical structure and disaccharide formation diagrams. No invented per-atom marking.
B2(b) is an either-fruit-or-vegetables choice under one 20-mark task; preserve full corresponding nutrition and dietary contribution guidance.
B3(a) and B4(a) require two points under EACH of three headings. Preservation method, mortgage and Local Authority scheme remain chosen profiles with dependent name/details.
B5(b) separately prices child and parent special-needs difficulties at 12 each. C3(b)(i) separately prices leisure definition 6 and value discussion 12.

C2(c) requires three independent manufacturing techniques (construction, colour, design) at five each for name plus description; keep each full five-mark criterion without inventing name/description sub-splits.
C1(c)(i) requires one reference to EACH of three headings plus three other points; do not invent two-per-heading quotas. C3(a)(ii) requires one per heading plus one other point.
C1(a)(ii) central heating has name 4, fuel 4, three principle points at 4 and impact 4. C1(b)(ii) ventilation name 3 plus three principle points at 4; preserve each method’s full source model.
C3(c)(ii) is two chosen childcare profiles, each name 3 plus two evaluative points at 3. The scheme names examples but supplies no model advantages/disadvantages; make that omission visible.

Original question inputs: A5 protein table, A6 heat-transfer table, A8 mould diagram, B1 food group serving table and C3 unemployment table; also retain the two original chemical answer diagrams from scheme page 8.
sourceAnomalies: Paper page11 unemployment table gives 2010 as13.7%, whereas scheme page18 repeats13.6%. The original paper is the input; show its13.7% and a visible note identifying the differing scheme value. Both paper and scheme prose mention14.4% October2011 while the table says14.2%; retain both without inventing correction.
Scheme A6 places Microwave cooking under Conduction. Retain the original printed classification, identified as source table wording.
Scheme B2(b) includes broad historical statements such as Fruit has no protein. Preserve the original marking guidance as exam-source material; do not rewrite nutritional content.
Paper C1(c) text layer carries a stray space inside (c ); normalize only the part-marker boundary. Original printed question prose is retained.

The carbohydrate printed equation on scheme8 uses H20 while its accompanying diagram labels H₂O. The complete original answer crop preserves both; no silently corrected diagram or formula is substituted.
